environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'doc-services-prod' fronted by an Envoy-based API gateway (Gloo Edge 1.16) configured with a gRPC-JSON transcoding filter. The transcoding filter's HttpRule annotations map GetDocument to 'GET /v1/documents/{file_path=*}' — the single-segment wildcard '{file_path=*}' in the google.api.http annotation means the gateway only matches a SINGLE path segment (no slashes permitted in the captured variable). Requests with file_path containing '/' or encoded slashes (%2F) are rejected at the gateway level with HTTP 400 before reaching the upstream gRPC service. The Envoy route configuration has 'path_rewrite' disabled and 'normalize_path: true' with 'merge_slashes: true' enabled on the HTTP connection manager. Additionally, the transcoding filter has 'reject_unknown_method: true' and 'reject_unknown_query_parameters: true' set. Direct pod-to-pod traffic on port 50051 is blocked by a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy that only permits ingress from the gateway pod's label selector (app=gloo-gateway) on the gRPC port.
